name: Loaded baked potato (the $20 potato in the takeaway box)
personality: PROPOSAL ($20 Potato, 4 Nov 2026): a cheerful loaded baked potato, perfectly happy in his cheese hot tub; the cast's 'unbothered cooked potato' cameo (callback to the crispy spud in Real Footage of Hell). One-off, not canon until Jonny says so.
notes: From hell/crispy-spud (same crisp eyes and small dark 3-finger gloves), a golden baked skin; the split top, sour cream dollop, cheese and chives are the worn prop loadedtop (props-winter.js). Jonny's brief 4 Nov: cheerful, warm, unharmed-looking, no wounds.
